name: Cast_Fire_Charge
note: two-hand cupped gather, tightening pulse; hands at chest

name: Cast_Water_Charge
note: orbiting hands, swaying body (figure-8), soft fingers

name: Cast_Water_Release
note: wave sweep of the right arm, low-left -> front -> high-right

name: Cast_Earth_Charge
note: horse stance, hands lift a boulder, right foot stomps at 60% of the loop

name: Cast_Earth_Release
note: lift both fists overhead, stomp + slam to the ground

name: Cast_Wind_Charge
note: both arms orbit at chest height (opposite phases), torso follows

name: Cast_Wind_Release
note: torso whip, right arm sweeps a wide arc from behind-right to far left

name: Cast_Lightning_Charge
note: right arm raised to the sky, snapped jitter, left fist at the hip, head up

name: Cast_Lightning_Release
note: arm snaps from the sky down to a pointed strike, recoil jitter

name: Cast_Ice_Charge
note: rigid crossed forearms at the chest, tiny frost tremor, shoulders raised

name: Cast_Ice_Release
note: crossed arms burst out into a stiff two-hand palm push, then hold frozen

name: Cast_Light_Charge
note: open palms raised in a V, slow rising swell

name: Cast_Light_Release
note: hands meet overhead, sweep down and forward: blessing / beam

name: Cast_Dark_Charge
note: hunched, low right claw creeping, left arm wrapped across the chest

name: Cast_Dark_Release
note: claw thrust forward then drag-pull, left arm cloak flare
